66246.recognize_zh: 視野中央一顆嗜中性球，細胞核分成約十個以上以細染色質絲相連的小葉，排成環狀（遠超過正常 5 葉的判讀門檻），細胞質為淡粉紅色細顆粒，是巨母紅血球性貧血（megaloblastic anemia）典型的過度分葉嗜中性球。
features: Mature neutrophil with approximately ten nuclear lobes connected by thin chromatin filaments, arranged in a ring
Lobes are small, dense and condensed; cytoplasm shows normal fine pink neutrophilic granulation
Neutrophil diameter slightly exceeds usual size, suggesting a macropolycyte
Background red cells are relatively uniform with mild anisocytosis and a few crenated cells; macro-ovalocytes are not clearly evident in this field
66246.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a markedly hypersegmented neutrophil with approximately ten small nuclear lobes joined by thin chromatin strands and normal cytoplasmic granulation. Surrounding red cells show mild anisocytosis with a few crenated forms; red cell size cannot be reliably judged from this single field and definite macro-ovalocytes are not identified. A single neutrophil with six or more lobes, or more than 5% with five lobes, is significant. Findings are consistent with megaloblastic change, most commonly due to vitamin B12 or folate deficiency, and correlation with MCV, B12, folate and methylmalonic acid is recommended.

ddx.vs: This benign familial trait affects many neutrophils in an otherwise normal smear with normal MCV and vitamin levels.
Morphology is identical; medication history and normal B12/folate levels separate it.
MDS more often shows hypolobated (pseudo-Pelger) and hypogranular neutrophils with cytopenias rather than prominent hypersegmentation.

ddx.dx: Iron deficiency or renal failure related hypersegmentation
ddx.vs: These show only mild hypersegmentation (5-6 lobes) with microcytic or normocytic red cells, not ten-lobed neutrophils.

exam.answer_en: Megaloblastic anemia — markedly hypersegmented neutrophil with about ten nuclear lobes connected by thin chromatin filaments
pearls_zh: 考法：數核葉；任一顆 ≥6 葉即有意義，此顆約 10 葉，答 hypersegmented neutrophil，推 megaloblastic anemia。
B12 與 folate 缺乏都會造成 DNA 合成障礙（thymidine 合成受阻）；methylmalonic acid 只在 B12 缺乏上升，homocysteine 兩者皆升。
骨髓：megaloblastic erythroid precursors（核質發育不同步）、giant metamyelocytes；LDH、indirect bilirubin 升高（ineffective erythropoiesis）。
補充 B12 後網狀紅血球約一週內上升；治療初期注意 hypokalemia。
藥物（methotrexate、hydroxyurea、azathioprine、zidovudine）可造成相同形態。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與 myelokathexis 混淆；myelokathexis 為少數圓形固縮核葉以極長細絲連接，megaloblastic 中性球核葉多、體積大（macropolycyte）。

quiz.q: 此中性球異常的判讀門檻為何？哪一個檢驗可區分 B12 缺乏與葉酸缺乏？
quiz.a: 任一顆 ≥6 葉（或 5 葉 >5%）；methylmalonic acid（僅 B12 缺乏時上升）。

66182.recognize_zh: 皮膚切片可見表皮均勻增厚、表皮突規則向下延伸（psoriasiform hyperplasia），角質層呈緻密粉紅色角化不全（parakeratosis），真皮乳頭有擴張微血管與輕度血管周圍淋巴組織球浸潤，符合 talquetamab 引起的乾癬樣反應。
features: Regular psoriasiform epidermal hyperplasia with elongated, evenly spaced rete ridges
Compact eosinophilic parakeratotic stratum corneum
Dilated capillaries within dermal papillae
No basal vacuolar interface change or dyskeratotic keratinocytes
Mild superficial perivascular lymphohistiocytic infiltrate without eosinophils
66182.describe_en: Skin biopsy shows regular psoriasiform epidermal hyperplasia with elongated rete ridges and compact parakeratosis of the stratum corneum. Dermal papillae contain dilated capillaries, and there is a sparse superficial perivascular lymphohistiocytic infiltrate. No interface dermatitis, necrotic keratinocytes or eosinophils are identified in this field. Findings are consistent with psoriasiform dermatitis, which in this clinical context supports a drug-associated psoriasis-like reaction to talquetamab.

ddx.vs: Histology overlaps; classic psoriasis shows neutrophils in parakeratosis (Munro microabscesses) and thinned suprapapillary plates, and separation relies on temporal association with the drug.
Eczematous dermatitis shows spongiosis and often eosinophils, which are not seen here.
Mycosis fungoides shows atypical lymphocytes with epidermotropism and Pautrier microabscesses, absent here.

ddx.dx: Cutaneous GVHD or drug-induced interface dermatitis
ddx.vs: These show basal vacuolar change with dyskeratotic keratinocytes, which are absent in this biopsy.

66118.recognize_zh: 右下方較大的單核球有豐富灰藍色胞質，胞質內聚集一群小型、邊緣深色、帶金黃色折光的結晶；旁邊的小淋巴球則沒有，背景紅血球鋸齒狀，符合單核球內的膽紅素結晶。
features: Monocyte-sized cell with abundant gray-blue cytoplasm and a large round-to-indented nucleus
Cluster of small refractile golden-yellow crystalline inclusions with dark outlines in the cytoplasm
Adjacent small lymphocyte lacks inclusions
Background crenated red cells with numerous small ring-like refractile drying artifacts, which limits interpretation of fine inclusions
Image is somewhat blurred
66118.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows crenated red cells with abundant refractile drying artifact. A monocyte with abundant gray-blue cytoplasm contains a cluster of small, refractile, golden-yellow crystalline inclusions, while an adjacent small lymphocyte is free of inclusions. Image resolution and background artifact limit detailed characterization of crystal shape. Findings are consistent with intracellular bilirubin crystals within a monocyte, a finding associated with marked hyperbilirubinemia.

ddx.vs: Drying artifact produces ring-like refractile bodies scattered over red cells and background, whereas true crystals are clustered within the leukocyte cytoplasm and show yellow color.
Hemosiderin appears as golden-brown to blue-black granules that are Prussian blue-positive, unlike iron-negative bright yellow bilirubin crystals.
Hemozoin is brown-black pigment accompanied by parasitized red cells, which are not seen here.

65862.recognize_zh: 視野中兩顆嗜中性球都分葉不足：上方一顆為雙葉、兩葉圓鈍靠在一起，下方一顆核呈 C 形/花生狀，但染色質已是成熟的粗塊狀，而非帶狀核的細緻染色質；背景多為皺縮紅血球（棘狀，屬抹片假影）。
features: Two neutrophils with hyposegmented nuclei: one bilobed with closely apposed rounded lobes, one C-shaped/peanut-shaped
Coarse, clumped mature chromatin in both cells despite hyposegmentation
Normal-appearing cytoplasmic granulation
Numerous crenated red cells (echinocytes) with refractile centers, consistent with drying artifact
Scattered platelets; no blasts in this field
65862.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows two neutrophils with hyposegmented nuclei, one bilobed and one C-shaped/peanut-shaped, both with coarse, clumped mature chromatin and preserved cytoplasmic granulation. Many red cells are crenated with refractile artifact, consistent with slow drying. Platelets are present and no blasts are seen. In the clinical context of infection-related leukocytosis, findings are consistent with pseudo-Pelger-Huët (acquired hyposegmented) neutrophils.

ddx.vs: Bands have less condensed chromatin and a uniformly wide, curved nucleus, whereas these cells show mature clumped chromatin with a hyposegmented shape.
Inherited anomaly affects essentially all neutrophils persistently and is familial, which morphology in a single field cannot distinguish.
MDS usually shows accompanying hypogranulation, cytopenias and dysplasia in other lineages.

exam.answer_en: Pseudo-Pelger-Huët neutrophils — hyposegmented (bilobed and peanut-shaped) nuclei with mature clumped chromatin, reactive to infection
pearls_zh: 考法：圖中有花生形/C 形核，考你會不會誤數為 band；關鍵是染色質已成熟粗塊狀，應歸為低分葉成熟嗜中性球。
若把 Pelger-Huët 型細胞算成 band，會造成假性 left shift，可能誤導為嚴重細菌感染的判斷。
WHO 形態學發育不良門檻：單一系列 ≥10% 細胞具發育不良才算 lineage dysplasia；單看少數低分葉細胞不能診斷 MDS。
背景皺縮紅血球為抹片乾燥假影，不應解讀為病理性 echinocytosis。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常被誤認為 band neutrophil；band 核寬度一致、染色質較細緻，這兩顆細胞雖分葉不足，染色質已粗塊凝集，屬成熟低分葉嗜中性球。

quiz.q: 圖下方花生形核的細胞應分類為 band 還是低分葉成熟嗜中性球？依據為何？
quiz.a: 低分葉（pseudo-Pelger）成熟嗜中性球；染色質粗塊狀成熟，非 band 的細緻染色質。

65798.recognize_zh: 中央一顆漿細胞，細胞核被推到一側、染色質呈車輪狀，細胞質完全被大小不一的淡藍色圓形空泡樣小球（Russell bodies）塞滿，像一串葡萄，即 Mott 細胞（葡萄細胞）。
features: Plasma cell with an eccentric, compressed nucleus showing clumped chromatin
Cytoplasm packed with numerous round, pale blue, variably sized globules (Russell bodies) giving a grape-cluster appearance
Globules are homogeneous and non-refractile, consistent with condensed immunoglobulin
Adjacent granulocytic precursors (myelocyte/metamyelocyte) and a band neutrophil for comparison
Background red cells in a thick area of the aspirate
65798.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a plasma cell with an eccentrically placed nucleus and cytoplasm distended by numerous round, pale blue, homogeneous globules of varying size, consistent with Russell bodies. Adjacent granulocytic precursors are present. Findings are consistent with a Mott cell. Mott cells reflect accumulation of immunoglobulin in dilated endoplasmic reticulum and are not specific for malignancy; in this patient they occur in the setting of multiple myeloma, and clonality should be established by light chain studies.

ddx.vs: Gaucher cells are large histiocytes with small nuclei and fibrillary crumpled tissue-paper cytoplasm rather than discrete round globules.
Dutcher bodies are intranuclear pseudoinclusions overlying the nucleus, whereas Russell bodies are cytoplasmic.
Burkitt cells have deeply basophilic cytoplasm with small clear lipid vacuoles and an immature nucleus rather than a mature plasma cell nucleus.
Foamy histiocytes have a central bland histiocytic nucleus and small uniform lipid vacuoles, without plasmacytoid features.

exam.answer_en: Mott cell (morula/grape cell) — plasma cell with eccentric nucleus and cytoplasm packed with multiple round pale Russell bodies
pearls_zh: 考法：指細胞質內淡藍圓球問名稱：Russell bodies，為免疫球蛋白堆積於擴張的 ER；含多顆 Russell bodies 的漿細胞稱 Mott cell。
Russell bodies 在細胞質、Dutcher bodies 為覆蓋於核上的核內假包涵體（PAS+），後者常見於 lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma 與 marginal zone lymphoma。
Mott cell 不代表惡性：可見於慢性發炎、自體免疫、感染，也可見於 myeloma；判斷腫瘤性需漿細胞比例、形態異型與 κ/λ 輕鏈限制。
相關漿細胞包涵體變化還有 flame cell（周邊洋紅色，IgA 相關）、crystal-storing histiocytosis 與 Fanconi syndrome 相關的輕鏈結晶。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與 Gaucher cell 或泡沫組織球混淆：Gaucher cell 細胞質呈皺紙樣纖維紋、核小；Mott cell 則有漿細胞的偏心車輪狀核，細胞質為分散的圓形均質小球。

quiz.q: 這顆漿細胞細胞質中大量淡藍色圓形小球叫什麼？整顆細胞稱為什麼？

64838.recognize_zh: 這不是顯微鏡圖，而是在紫外光（UV）照射下的檢體試管照片：左側病人羊水管底發出明亮紅橙色螢光，右側健康對照管則無紅色螢光，表示羊水中含大量卟啉，支持胎兒紅血球生成型卟啉症。
features: Photograph of two specimen tubes under ultraviolet (Wood's lamp-type) illumination
Left tube (patient amniotic fluid): bright red-orange fluorescence of the fluid
Right tube (healthy control): colorless fluid without red fluorescence
Blue background glare from the UV source; no microscopic detail present
64838.describe_en: Photograph of amniotic fluid specimens under ultraviolet light shows intense red-orange fluorescence in the patient sample (left) compared with no red fluorescence in the healthy control (right). Red fluorescence under UV indicates high porphyrin content, and the reported fluorimetric emission peak at 619 nm supports porphyrin excess. This is a qualitative screening result, not a morphologic finding. In the context of fetal hydrops with fluorocytes in fetal blood, it supports an erythropoietic porphyria such as congenital erythropoietic porphyria, which requires quantitative porphyrin fractionation and UROS gene testing.

ddx.vs: Alloimmune hemolysis raises bilirubin (optical density at 450 nm) in amniotic fluid but does not produce red porphyrin fluorescence.
Discolored fluid appears green or red in visible light but does not emit red fluorescence under UV.

ddx.dx: Other porphyrias (hepatic, such as porphyria cutanea tarda)
ddx.vs: Porphyrin fractionation separates uroporphyrin I/coproporphyrin I predominance in CEP from other profiles.

65734.recognize_zh: 血片中許多紅血球的血紅素被推擠到一側、另一側留下清亮新月形區域（偏心紅血球 eccentrocyte），另有小而緻密、邊緣不規則的 pyknocyte 及少數標靶細胞；電泳顯示 Hb C 約 38.5%，符合 G6PD 缺乏合併 Hb C 帶因的氧化性溶血。
features: Numerous eccentrocytes: hemoglobin condensed to one side with a sharply demarcated clear crescent at the opposite margin
Pyknocytes: small, dense, irregularly contracted red cells lacking central pallor
Occasional target cells
Scattered normal platelets and a single mononuclear leukocyte; no spherocyte-predominant or schistocyte pattern
Hemoglobin electrophoresis: Hb A 57.2%, Hb C or variant 38.5%, Hb A2 4.0%, Hb F 0.3%
65734.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows many eccentrocytes with hemoglobin displaced to one side of the cell and a clear crescentic rim, admixed with dense contracted pyknocytes and occasional target cells; schistocytes are not prominent. Platelets are adequate and the single leukocyte in the field is unremarkable. The accompanying hemoglobin electrophoresis shows Hb A 57.2% and a Hb C/variant fraction of 38.5%, consistent with Hb C trait. Findings are consistent with acute oxidant hemolysis, supporting G6PD deficiency with coexisting Hb C trait; confirmation by G6PD enzyme assay after recovery is advised.

ddx.vs: Spherocytes are round, uniformly dense cells lacking the eccentric clear crescent, with a positive osmotic fragility or EMA binding test.

ddx.dx: Hemoglobin C disease or SC disease
ddx.vs: Homozygous Hb C and SC show abundant target cells and intraerythrocytic crystals with Hb C near 50-100%, rather than eccentrocytes with Hb C trait levels.

ddx.dx: Bite cells from Heinz body removal
ddx.vs: Bite cells show a notched concavity at the margin, whereas eccentrocytes retain the membrane with a clear hemoglobin-free zone; both suggest oxidant injury.
Unstable hemoglobins produce similar oxidant morphology but show chronic hemolysis, a positive isopropanol test and a variant peak distinct from Hb C.

exam.answer_en: Acute oxidant hemolysis (G6PD deficiency with Hb C trait) — numerous eccentrocytes and pyknocytes; Hb C ~38.5% on electrophoresis
pearls_zh: 考法：指一側清亮新月的紅血球問名稱：eccentrocyte（hemighost 概念相近），代表氧化傷害使膜內面交聯、血紅素被推向一側；再問下一步：Heinz body 超活體染色（crystal violet 或 new methylene blue）。
G6PD 缺乏為 X 染色體連鎖；台灣新生兒篩檢已常規納入（俗稱蠶豆症）。誘發因素：蠶豆、感染、primaquine、dapsone、rasburicase、methylene blue 等氧化性藥物。
急性溶血期 G6PD 活性可因網狀紅血球（酵素活性高）而假性正常，應於恢復後（常建議約 2–3 個月）重測或同時校正網狀紅血球。
Hb C 為 β6 Glu→Lys；Hb C trait 約佔 30–40%，常見標靶細胞但不溶血；HbCC 與 HbSC 才會有 Hb C 結晶與明顯溶血。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把 pyknocyte 或 eccentrocyte 誤判為 spherocyte：球形紅血球均勻緻密、無偏心清亮區，見於 HS 或 AIHA；eccentrocyte 有清楚偏心新月清亮區，提示氧化性溶血。

quiz.q: 圖中血紅素擠向一側、另一側留有清亮新月的紅血球叫什麼？提示哪一類溶血機轉？
quiz.a: Eccentrocytes；氧化性溶血（如 G6PD 缺乏）

65670.recognize_zh: 臨床照片可見雙眼鞏膜呈均勻的黃褐色，眼周皮膚色調偏黃；配合病史（重度再生不良性貧血、高劑量 eltrombopag）且肝功能正常，應考慮藥物引起的皮膚與鞏膜變色，而非真正的膽紅素性黃疸。
features: Bilateral diffuse yellow to yellow-brown discoloration of the bulbar conjunctiva/sclera
Discoloration involves both eyes symmetrically
Subtle yellowish tint of periorbital and facial skin
No visible conjunctival hemorrhage, pallor-related findings, or periorbital purpura in this view
65670.describe_en: Clinical photograph of the face shows bilateral, symmetric yellow to yellow-brown discoloration of the sclerae with a subtle yellowish tint of the surrounding skin. No subconjunctival hemorrhage or periorbital purpura is seen. The photograph alone cannot distinguish true icterus from pigment deposition; given normal liver function tests in a patient receiving high-dose eltrombopag, the findings are consistent with eltrombopag-associated skin and scleral discoloration rather than hyperbilirubinemia.

ddx.vs: True icterus is accompanied by elevated serum bilirubin, whereas eltrombopag-related discoloration occurs with normal bilirubin and liver tests.
Carotenemia yellows the palms, soles, and nasolabial skin but characteristically spares the sclerae.
Drug-induced liver injury raises transaminases and bilirubin, which were normal in this patient.

ddx.dx: Hemolysis from an expanding PNH clone in aplastic anemia
ddx.vs: PNH-related hemolysis shows elevated indirect bilirubin and LDH, low haptoglobin, and a PNH clone by flow cytometry.

65606.recognize_zh: 臨床照片可見手指與腳趾末端發黑壞死；血液抹片中的嗜中性球與單核球細胞質被多個大小不一、淡藍灰色的圓形球狀包涵體撐滿，細胞核被擠壓變形，這是被吞噬的冷凝球蛋白沉澱物。
features: Clinical photographs of dry gangrene/necrosis of fingertips and toes with dusky discoloration (panels A-B, F-G)
Neutrophils and monocytes distended by multiple round, pale blue-gray, homogeneous globular cytoplasmic inclusions (panels C-E, H-J)
Nuclei compressed and molded around the inclusions
Inclusions vary in size, from small vacuole-like globules to large globules filling most of the cytoplasm
Crystalline red cell inclusions not clearly resolved at this resolution
65606.describe_en: Composite figure includes clinical photographs showing necrosis of the distal fingers and toes. Peripheral blood smear panels show neutrophils and monocytes containing multiple round, homogeneous, pale blue-gray globular inclusions of varying size that distend the cytoplasm and indent the nuclei, consistent with phagocytosed precipitated protein. No organisms are identified within the inclusions. In the setting of digital gangrene, low complement, and a monoclonal immunoglobulin, findings are consistent with cryoglobulin precipitates in the blood smear; because these cryoglobulins were heat-insoluble, correlation with cryoglobulin testing at higher temperatures is essential.

ddx.vs: Toxic vacuoles are small, empty, and accompanied by toxic granulation and Döhle bodies, whereas these are large homogeneous gray-blue globules filling the cytoplasm.
Organisms have defined internal structure (nuclei, capsules, morulae), whereas cryoglobulin globules are structureless and homogeneous.
These are giant azurophilic granules staining red-purple, not pale homogeneous gray-blue globules.
Storage artifact produces small clear vacuoles in otherwise normal cells, without large globular inclusions or clinical ischemia.

65478.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中央有一顆比周圍細胞大好幾倍的組織球，細胞質被大量大小相近、邊界清楚的透明小空泡填滿，呈泡沫或肥皂泡狀，核小而偏中央、染色較深。這種「泡沫細胞」是 Niemann-Pick 細胞的樣子，但需與其他泡沫組織球鑑別。
features: Very large histiocyte, roughly 5–6 times the diameter of adjacent red cells
Cytoplasm packed with numerous small, sharply defined, fairly uniform clear vacuoles (foamy/soap-bubble appearance)
Small, relatively condensed central nucleus with irregular outline
Faint lilac cytoplasmic strands between vacuoles; no striated 'crumpled tissue paper' texture
Background marrow elements including erythroid precursors and myeloid cells
65478.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a very large histiocyte whose cytoplasm is filled with numerous small, sharply defined, uniform clear vacuoles, imparting a foamy soap-bubble appearance, with a small central nucleus. The cytoplasm lacks the fibrillary crumpled-tissue-paper texture of Gaucher cells. Surrounding hematopoietic cells, including erythroid and myeloid precursors, are present. Findings are consistent with a Niemann-Pick cell (foamy lipid-laden histiocyte); confirmation with sphingomyelinase activity or SMPD1/NPC1/NPC2 genetic testing is required, as sea-blue histiocytes and other foamy macrophages can overlap.

ddx.vs: Gaucher cells have fibrillary, striated 'crumpled tissue paper' cytoplasm without discrete vacuoles and are strongly PAS and tartrate-resistant acid phosphatase positive.
Sea-blue histiocytes contain blue-green ceroid granules on Giemsa, whereas this cell shows clear uniform vacuoles; both may coexist in Niemann-Pick disease.

ddx.dx: Pseudo-Gaucher or foamy cells in high cell-turnover states (CML, thalassemia, myeloma)
ddx.vs: Secondary foamy histiocytes appear in increased cell-turnover conditions and have normal enzyme activity, so clinical and biochemical correlation is needed.

ddx.dx: Fat cell or lipid-laden macrophage in marrow
ddx.vs: Adipocytes show one or few large vacuoles with a peripheral flattened nucleus rather than numerous small uniform vacuoles.

exam.answer_en: Niemann-Pick disease — large foamy histiocyte with uniform soap-bubble vacuoles (Niemann-Pick cell) in bone marrow
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指這顆泡沫狀大組織球問「Gaucher 還是 Niemann-Pick？」均勻肥皂泡空泡＝Niemann-Pick；條紋皺紙紋理＝Gaucher。
Types A/B（ASMD）為 SMPD1 突變致 acid sphingomyelinase 缺乏、堆積 sphingomyelin；type C 為 NPC1/NPC2 突變致膽固醇運輸異常。
確診：ASMD 測白血球或乾血片的 acid sphingomyelinase 活性；NPC 酶活性正常，需靠 oxysterol 等生物標記與基因檢測。
臨床：type A 嬰兒期神經退化、黃斑 cherry-red spot；type B 以肝脾腫大、間質性肺病、血脂異常為主，神經症狀少。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常誤認為 Gaucher cell；Niemann-Pick 細胞為均勻圓形空泡的泡沫狀，Gaucher 細胞質為條紋狀皺紙紋理且 PAS 強陽性。

quiz.q: 圖中泡沫細胞若屬 Niemann-Pick type A/B，缺乏的是哪個酵素？

65286.recognize_zh: 上方細胞有灰藍色細胞質，核已分成兩團染色體（分裂後期/末期的有絲分裂像）；下方細胞有深藍色細胞質、核圓且染色質呈粗點狀，是嗜鹼性紅血球母細胞；背景可見多染性大紅血球與淚滴形紅血球，符合巨母紅血球性造血中活躍的紅系增生。
features: Mitotic erythroid precursor in anaphase/telophase with two separated chromosome clusters in grey-blue cytoplasm
Basophilic erythroblast with deeply blue cytoplasm and a round nucleus with coarsely stippled chromatin
Both precursors enlarged relative to normoblastic counterparts
Large polychromatophilic red cell and teardrop cells in the background
Anisopoikilocytosis with fragmented and irregular red cells; smear stroma at upper right
65286.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows two erythroid precursors. The upper cell is an enlarged erythroid precursor in late mitosis (anaphase/telophase), and the lower cell is a basophilic erythroblast with intensely basophilic cytoplasm and a round nucleus with stippled chromatin. The background red cells show anisopoikilocytosis with large polychromatophilic cells and teardrop forms. The findings reflect erythroid proliferation with megaloblastic features, consistent with B12/folate deficiency.

ddx.dx: Erythroid hyperplasia of hemolysis or blood loss
ddx.vs: Reactive erythroid hyperplasia shows increased mitoses but normoblastic, size-appropriate precursors with synchronous chromatin condensation.
Pure erythroid leukemia shows sheets of immature erythroid cells with atypical mitoses and multinucleation rather than a complete, maturing megaloblastic series.
Atypical mitoses show three or more chromosome clusters or lagging chromosomes, whereas this division is bipolar.

65222.recognize_zh: 新生兒周邊血中多顆淋巴球的細胞質內充滿大小一致、邊界清楚的空泡，旁邊的嗜中性球則形態正常；X 光可見左足蹠骨內收，合併臨床表現應懷疑溶小體儲積症（此例為 GM1 gangliosidosis）。
features: Small to medium mature lymphocytes with round to slightly indented nuclei and clumped chromatin (B-F)
Multiple sharply punched-out, clear, round cytoplasmic vacuoles, often filling the cytoplasm and indenting the nucleus
Thin rim of pale blue cytoplasm; no azurophilic granules or Alder-Reilly-type inclusions within the lymphocytes
Adjacent neutrophil with normal segmentation and granulation (C)
Radiograph of left foot showing metatarsus adductus (A)
65222.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows frequent lymphocytes containing numerous discrete, clear, round cytoplasmic vacuoles that in some cells fill the cytoplasm and indent the nucleus. The lymphocyte nuclei are otherwise mature, and an adjacent neutrophil is morphologically unremarkable; red cells and platelets show no specific abnormality in these fields. The accompanying radiograph shows metatarsus adductus of the left foot. In a neonate with hypotonia and skeletal abnormalities, vacuolated lymphocytes are suggestive of a lysosomal storage disorder; confirmatory urine oligosaccharide/glycosaminoglycan testing, enzyme assay and GLB1 sequencing support GM1 gangliosidosis.

ddx.dx: Pompe disease (glycogen storage disease type II)
ddx.vs: Pompe lymphocytes show vacuoles that are PAS-positive glycogen, and diagnosis requires acid alpha-glucosidase assay; morphology alone cannot separate the storage disorders.
MPS typically shows metachromatic Alder-Reilly granules in neutrophils/lymphocytes rather than clear punched-out vacuoles.
Juvenile NCL shows vacuolated lymphocytes but presents later with visual loss, and is confirmed by CLN3 testing rather than beta-galactosidase deficiency.
Artifactual vacuolation affects many cell types after prolonged EDTA storage and is irregular, whereas here vacuoles are uniform, restricted to lymphocytes and seen in a fresh smear.

exam.answer_en: Lysosomal storage disorder (GM1 gangliosidosis) — neonatal blood lymphocytes with multiple sharply punched-out cytoplasmic vacuoles
pearls_zh: 考法：新生兒或嬰兒抹片指淋巴球內多個清楚圓形空泡，問應懷疑哪一類疾病與下一步；答 lysosomal storage disorder，做酵素活性與基因檢測。
空泡淋巴球可見於 GM1 gangliosidosis、Pompe disease（PAS 陽性）、Niemann-Pick、Wolman disease、sialidosis、I-cell disease、juvenile NCL（CLN3）。
GM1 gangliosidosis：GLB1 突變致 β-galactosidase 缺乏；嬰兒型有低張力、dysostosis multiplex、肝脾腫大，可見 cherry-red spot。
形態無法分辨各儲積症；需確認抹片新鮮、空泡主要在淋巴球，並結合尿液 oligosaccharide/GAG 與酵素檢查。
exam.pitfall_zh: 常被當成 EDTA 放置過久的人工空泡；人工空泡不規則且多種細胞皆有，儲積症空泡大小一致、打孔狀、主要在淋巴球，新鮮抹片即可見。

quiz.q: 圖中淋巴球細胞質內多個清楚圓形空泡，在低張力新生兒應懷疑哪一類疾病？此例缺乏何種酵素？

65158.recognize_zh: 高倍下母細胞核偏心、染色質細緻，淡灰藍色細胞質偏向一側且邊緣有成排的小空泡與偽足狀突起，這種無顆粒、帶周邊小空泡的母細胞是 BPDCN 的典型形態線索。
features: Medium to large blastoid cells with fine, evenly dispersed chromatin
Round to irregular or slightly indented nuclei, eccentrically placed
Pale grey-blue agranular cytoplasm polarized to one side with pseudopod-like tails
Small cytoplasmic vacuoles arranged beneath the cell membrane in some cells
Scattered small lymphocytes and nucleated red cells in the background
65158.describe_en: High-power view of a Wright-stained smear shows numerous medium to large blastoid cells with eccentric, round to irregular nuclei and fine chromatin. The cytoplasm is agranular, pale grey-blue and polarized, forming pseudopod-like extensions, and several cells show small vacuoles lining the cytoplasmic membrane. No Auer rods or granules are seen; small lymphocytes and nucleated red cells are present for comparison. Findings are consistent with blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm in the context of the supporting immunophenotype.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with monocytic differentiation
ddx.vs: Monocytic blasts may show vacuoles and pseudopods but usually carry fine granules and nonspecific esterase activity, and lack the CD4+/CD56+/CD123 bright/TCF4+ pDC profile.
Burkitt cells have deeply basophilic cytoplasm with prominent lipid vacuoles throughout and are mature B-cell (CD19/CD20/CD10+), unlike these pale-cytoplasm CD19-negative cells.
T-lymphoblasts are cytoplasmic CD3 and TdT positive, both negative here.

exam.answer_en: Blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm — blasts with fine chromatin, pseudopod-like tails and a row of small submembrane cytoplasmic vacuoles
pearls_zh: 考法：高倍下指細胞膜下方排成一串的小空泡（pearl-necklace 樣）與偽足狀突起，這是 BPDCN 在抹片上常被考的型態線索。
細胞化學：MPO、Sudan black B 陰性，NSE 陰性或僅弱陽性；此組合可與大部分 AML 區分。
IHC 除 CD123 外，TCF4 與 TCL1 核/質陽性很有幫助；CD303（BDCA-2）特異但敏感度較低。部分病例 TdT 可陽性，不代表 lymphoblastic leukemia。
預後差、復發率高；tagraxofusp 為 CD123 導向治療，年輕體能佳者於緩解後接受 allogeneic HSCT。
exam.pitfall_zh: 細胞膜下小空泡易讓人聯想 Burkitt（L3）細胞；Burkitt 細胞質深藍、空泡散佈全細胞且覆蓋核上，BPDCN 細胞質淡灰藍、空泡沿膜排列，表型 CD123+ 而非 CD10+/CD19+。

quiz.q: 圖中 blast 細胞膜下成排的小空泡與偏極化細胞質提示哪個疾病？哪個細胞化學染色應為陰性？

65094.recognize_zh: 高倍下萎縮的生發中心幾乎沒有中心母細胞，只剩粉紅色玻璃樣物質、樹突狀細胞與內皮細胞；一條小血管從右側穿入中心，外圍小淋巴球呈同心圓排列，構成「棒棒糖」（lollipop）濾泡。
features: Regressed germinal center depleted of centroblasts and centrocytes, with eosinophilic hyaline material
Small penetrating vessel with plump endothelial cells entering the germinal center from the side (lollipop)
Residual follicular dendritic and endothelial cells with vesicular, oval nuclei in the center
Mantle zone of small round lymphocytes arranged in concentric layers around the center
Surrounding interfollicular area with plump endothelial-lined vessels and scattered red cells
65094.describe_en: High-power view of a lymph node follicle shows a small, regressed germinal center depleted of lymphoid cells and replaced by eosinophilic hyaline material, follicular dendritic cells and endothelial cells. A small vessel with plump endothelium penetrates the germinal center from the periphery, producing the lollipop configuration. The mantle zone consists of small mature lymphocytes arranged in concentric layers. No atypical large cells are identified. Findings are consistent with Castleman disease-type regressed follicles, as seen in TAFRO-type idiopathic multicentric Castleman disease.

ddx.dx: Reactive lymph node with atrophic follicles (HIV, autoimmune disease, post-chemotherapy)
ddx.vs: Regressed follicles can occur in other settings, so lollipop follicles are not specific and must be integrated with hypervascularity, clinical criteria (TAFRO features) and exclusion of HIV, HHV-8 and autoimmune disease.
Unicentric disease shows similar lollipop follicles, often with more twinning and FDC dysplasia, but presents as a single enlarged node without systemic symptoms.
AITL shows regressed follicles with expanded perivascular FDC meshworks and atypical clear CD10/PD-1-positive T cells in the interfollicular zone, which are not present here.

exam.answer_en: Castleman-type lymphadenopathy (TAFRO context) — regressed hyalinized germinal center with a penetrating vessel and concentric mantle (lollipop follicle)
pearls_zh: 考法：指這個濾泡問名稱，答 lollipop follicle（穿入血管 + 萎縮玻璃樣生發中心 + 同心圓 mantle zone，即 onion-skin）。
TAFRO 為 idiopathic MCD 的亞型：Thrombocytopenia、Anasarca、Fever、Reticulin fibrosis/Renal dysfunction、Organomegaly；免疫球蛋白多僅輕度升高。
診斷 iMCD 前必須排除 HHV8（LANA-1 IHC 或血中 viral load）、淋巴瘤、自體免疫疾病與 IgG4 相關疾病等類似表現。
骨髓常見 reticulin fibrosis 與 megakaryocyte 增生；iMCD 一線治療為 anti-IL-6 的 siltuximab，重症 TAFRO 常需併用類固醇等強化治療。
exam.pitfall_zh: Lollipop 濾泡不是特異發現，易被直接判成 unicentric hyaline-vascular Castleman；同樣變化見於 iMCD/TAFRO、HIV、自體免疫疾病與淋巴瘤旁，須配合臨床分布與 HHV8 染色。

quiz.q: 圖中血管從側面穿入萎縮生發中心、外圍 mantle 呈同心圓排列的濾泡稱為什麼？TAFRO 的五個字母各代表什麼？

64966.recognize_zh: 拼圖中的淋巴球大小為小至中型，核形不規則，有明顯的裂溝、凹陷甚至腦回狀（convoluted）外觀，細胞質少而偏嗜鹼性、邊緣可見小突起，大量出現在周邊血，配合 T 細胞表型支持 T 細胞前淋巴球性白血病（T-PLL）。
features: Small-to-medium lymphoid cells, about 1.5-2 times the diameter of a red cell
Irregular nuclear contours with clefts, indentations and convoluted/cerebriform folding
Moderately condensed chromatin; nucleoli not conspicuous at this magnification
Scant to moderate basophilic cytoplasm, focally with small cytoplasmic protrusions/blebs
Background red cells unremarkable; no smudge-cell predominance
64966.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows lymphocytosis composed of small-to-medium lymphoid cells with scant basophilic cytoplasm, some with cytoplasmic blebs, and markedly irregular nuclei showing clefts, indentations and convolutions. Chromatin is moderately condensed, and nucleoli are not prominent in these images. Red cells appear unremarkable. In conjunction with flow cytometry showing a CD2+, CD3+, CD5+, CD7+, CD8+, CD4-, TdT- T-cell population, findings are consistent with T-cell prolymphocytic leukemia; TCL1A/MTCP1 rearrangement studies are recommended.

ddx.vs: Sézary cells have deeply cerebriform nuclei and are typically CD4+ with loss of CD7 and CD26, whereas T-PLL is usually CD7+ with TCL1 overexpression.
ATLL shows polylobated flower cells, CD4+/CD25+ phenotype and HTLV-1 seropositivity.
T-LGL cells have round nuclei and abundant pale cytoplasm with azurophilic granules and a CD8+/CD57+ indolent phenotype.
MCL cells with cleaved nuclei are B cells (CD19/CD20+, CD5+, cyclin D1+) rather than CD3+ T cells.

exam.answer_en: T-cell prolymphocytic leukemia — circulating small-to-medium lymphoid cells with irregular, cleft to cerebriform nuclei and cytoplasmic blebs
pearls_zh: 考法：看到周邊血大量核不規則、帶細胞質小突起（blebs）的淋巴球，要能提出 T-PLL 並與 Sézary syndrome、ATLL 鑑別。
遺傳：inv(14)(q11q32) 或 t(14;14) 導致 TCL1A 活化最常見，少數 t(X;14) 活化 MTCP1；ATM 異常常見，complex karyotype 多。
表型：成熟 T 細胞 TdT−、CD1a−，CD2/CD3/CD5/CD7 陽性，CD7 通常強表現；多為 CD4+CD8−，亦可 CD4+CD8+；TCL1 IHC 陽性。
臨床：白血球極高、肝脾腫大、皮膚浸潤與漿膜腔積液；CD52 高表現，alemtuzumab 為一線藥物，適合者接 allogeneic HSCT。
exam.pitfall_zh: 腦回狀核易被誤判為 Sézary cells；Sézary syndrome 以紅皮症為主、常 CD7 與 CD26 缺失，T-PLL 則 CD7 強陽性、TCL1 陽性並有 inv(14)。ATLL 為花瓣狀核且 HTLV-1 陽性。

quiz.q: 這種核不規則、帶小突起的循環 T 淋巴球若有 inv(14)，受活化的致癌基因是什麼？一線標靶藥物為何？

64902.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中細胞緊密成片，核圓且偏位，染色質呈粗塊狀的車輪狀（clockface）排列，胞質嗜雙色、量中等，藍色箭頭所指為典型漿細胞，構成漿細胞聚集。
features: Sheet-like aggregate of plasma cells between adipocytes
Round, eccentrically placed nuclei with coarse clockface (cartwheel) chromatin
Moderate amphophilic to eosinophilic cytoplasm; some perinuclear clearing
Relatively uniform mature-appearing cells without prominent nucleoli
Few residual hematopoietic cells and a small vessel at the right edge
64902.describe_en: H&E-stained bone marrow trephine section shows a dense interstitial aggregate of plasma cells between fat spaces. The cells have round, eccentric nuclei with coarse clockface chromatin and moderate amphophilic cytoplasm, and appear predominantly mature without prominent nucleoli or significant pleomorphism. Residual hematopoietic elements are sparse in this field. Findings are consistent with a plasma cell aggregate; clonality should be confirmed with CD138 and kappa/lambda studies, supporting plasma cell myeloma in this clinical context.

ddx.vs: Hairy cells have central oval or bean-shaped nuclei widely spaced by clear cytoplasm ('fried egg'), without clockface chromatin or eccentric nuclei.
Reactive plasma cells are scattered or perivascular and polytypic rather than forming confluent sheets.

ddx.dx: Marginal zone lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation
ddx.vs: This shows an accompanying CD20+ B-cell component with plasma cells sharing the same light chain.
Erythroblasts have central, very round dense nuclei with clear or scant cytoplasm and form colonies, and are E-cadherin or CD71 positive rather than CD138 positive.

64646.recognize_zh: 淋巴結濾泡間區被中等大小、細胞質透明的淋巴細胞浸潤（A 插圖），並表現 CD3、異常 CD20 與 PD-1、ICOS 等 TFH 標記（B–E）；另一群小而圓、染色質細的母細胞樣細胞呈 CD4/CD8 雙陽性且 TdT 陽性、成片聚集（F–J），代表合併惰性 T 淋巴母細胞增生（iT-LBP）。
features: Panel A: lymph node with a residual follicle and expanded interfollicular zone containing medium-sized atypical lymphocytes with clear cytoplasm (inset), with prominent small vessels
Panels B-E: neoplastic cells show membranous CD3, aberrant CD20, and TFH markers PD-1 and ICOS
Panel F: second patchy component of small-to-medium round blastoid lymphocytes with fine chromatin and scant cytoplasm around high endothelial venules
Panels G-I: blastoid component shows dim CD5 with CD4 and CD8 co-expression (double-positive)
Panel J: TdT highlights a discrete aggregate of nuclear-positive cells in an interfollicular region at low power
64646.describe_en: Lymph node sections show partial effacement by an interfollicular infiltrate of medium-sized atypical lymphocytes with clear cytoplasm, admixed with arborizing small vessels and a residual follicle. The atypical cells express CD3 and aberrant CD20 and are positive for the TFH markers PD-1 and ICOS. A second, patchy population of small-to-medium blastoid lymphocytes with fine chromatin and scant cytoplasm is present in interfollicular areas; these cells show dim CD5, dual CD4/CD8 expression and nuclear TdT, forming discrete aggregates rather than sheets. Findings are consistent with nodal peripheral T-cell lymphoma of T-follicular helper phenotype with an associated indolent T-lymphoblastic proliferation; clonality studies of the TdT-positive component help exclude T-lymphoblastic lymphoma.

ddx.vs: T-LBL forms confluent sheets effacing the node with clonal TCR rearrangement and a mediastinal/marrow presentation, whereas iT-LBP forms small nonclonal interfollicular TdT+ clusters.
Thymic TdT+ CD4/CD8 double-positive T cells are accompanied by a keratin-positive epithelial meshwork, which is not present in this node.
Reactive paracortex lacks clear-cell atypical lymphocytes with aberrant CD20 and coordinated PD-1/ICOS/CXCL13 expression, and lacks TdT+ blast aggregates.

ddx.dx: Classic Hodgkin lymphoma or EBV+ large B-cell proliferation
ddx.vs: These are defined by CD30+ CD15+ Hodgkin cells or EBV+ large B cells, whereas the dominant population here is CD3+ TFH-phenotype T cells with only scattered EBV+ cells.

64646.stain: H&E; IHC: CD3, CD20, PD-1, ICOS, CD5, CD4, CD8, TdT

64518.recognize_zh: 一個遠大於周圍細胞的巨核細胞，核分葉、細胞質豐富呈淡紫色細顆粒狀，左上方細胞質邊緣碎裂成大量小血小板顆粒，代表巨核細胞正在釋出血小板。
features: Very large cell, many times the diameter of surrounding red cells
Lobulated nucleus with moderately condensed chromatin
Abundant pale lilac finely granular cytoplasm
Cytoplasmic periphery fragmenting into numerous platelets along one side (platelet shedding)
Small lymphocytes and erythroid cells nearby for size comparison
64518.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a mature megakaryocyte with a lobulated nucleus and abundant finely granular lilac cytoplasm. Along one border the cytoplasm fragments into numerous platelets, indicating active platelet production. Nearby small lymphocytes and red cells provide scale. Findings are consistent with a normal mature megakaryocyte releasing platelets.

ddx.vs: Micromegakaryocytes are small, near the size of a myelocyte, with a single round nucleus, unlike this large lobulated cell.
Osteoclasts contain multiple separate round nuclei rather than a single lobulated nucleus, and they do not shed platelets.
Tumor clusters are cohesive groups of several cells with high N:C ratio and no granular cytoplasm budding into platelets.

64262.recognize_zh: 低倍周邊血中散佈多個細長、兩端尖的鐮刀狀紅血球（sickle cells），並有標示的有核紅血球（NRBC）與後髓細胞（metamyelocyte），白血球明顯增多，符合鐮刀型貧血危象時的骨髓應激反應。
features: Scattered elongated, crescent-shaped sickle cells with pointed ends throughout the field
Circulating nucleated red blood cells with small dense nuclei and eosinophilic cytoplasm (labeled)
Increased leukocytes, mostly segmented neutrophils, with a left shift including a metamyelocyte (labeled)
Background anisopoikilocytosis with occasional target cells
Scattered small dark blue particles consistent with platelets and/or stain precipitate
64262.describe_en: Low-power view of a peripheral blood smear shows leukocytosis composed predominantly of segmented neutrophils with a left shift, including a metamyelocyte. Numerous circulating nucleated red blood cells are present. Red cells show anisopoikilocytosis with scattered irreversibly sickled cells and occasional target cells. Findings are consistent with sickle cell disease with nucleated red cells and a leukoerythroblastic-type stress response, as seen in sickle cell crisis.

ddx.vs: HbSC shows fewer classic sickle cells and more target cells, folded cells and blunt-ended crystalline HbC-SC forms; hemoglobin electrophoresis/HPLC separates them.
Marrow infiltration or myelofibrosis shows NRBC and immature granulocytes with teardrop cells rather than sickle cells.
Elliptocytes are oval with blunt rounded ends and uniform hemoglobin, whereas sickle cells are crescentic with pointed ends.
Lymphocytes have a thin rim of pale blue cytoplasm, whereas NRBC have round pyknotic nuclei within pink to polychromatic hemoglobinized cytoplasm.

exam.answer_en: Sickle cell disease in crisis — irreversibly sickled cells with circulating nucleated RBCs and neutrophilic leukocytosis with left shift
pearls_zh: 考法：低倍圖先找兩端尖的鐮刀形紅血球，再指標示的 NRBC 或 metamyelocyte 問其出現意義（溶血與缺氧造成的骨髓壓力反應）。
分子：HBB 第 6 個胺基酸 Glu→Val（HbS），去氧時聚合；確診靠 Hb electrophoresis/HPLC，sickle solubility test 無法區分 trait 與 disease。
常見急症：血管阻塞疼痛危象、acute chest syndrome、脾隔離危象、parvovirus B19 引起的 aplastic crisis（網狀紅血球極低）。
治療：hydroxyurea 提高 HbF 以減少危象；acute chest syndrome 或中風需輸血或換血。
自動血球計數可能把 NRBC 算成白血球，需校正白血球數。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把 NRBC 當成小淋巴球、或把 elliptocyte 當成 sickle cell；NRBC 核小而濃縮且細胞質含血紅素，elliptocyte 兩端圓鈍，sickle cell 兩端尖。

quiz.q: 圖中標示的有核紅色細胞是什麼？其出現代表什麼？
quiz.a: Nucleated RBC（NRBC）；溶血/缺氧造成的骨髓造血壓力反應。

64326.recognize_zh: 視野中央上方一顆組織球的空泡化細胞質內聚集十多顆大小一致的小卵圓形酵母菌，每顆有偏心深染核與透明暈，周圍是造血細胞，符合骨髓內播散性組織胞漿菌症。
features: Macrophage with vacuolated cytoplasm containing a cluster of small, uniform oval yeasts (about 2-4 um)
Yeasts with eccentric dark-staining nuclear material and a surrounding clear halo
Additional histiocytes with foamy, vacuolated cytoplasm
Background hematopoietic cells including erythroid precursors, granulocytic precursors with orange-red granules, and lymphocytes
Quick stain with brownish cast and thick areas limiting fine detail
64326.describe_en: Rapid-stained bedside smear with marrow cellularity shows a macrophage containing a cluster of small, uniform oval intracellular yeasts with eccentric nuclear staining and a clear halo, along with other vacuolated histiocytes. Background hematopoietic elements include erythroid and granulocytic precursors and lymphocytes. Definite hemophagocytosis is not clearly identified in this field. Findings are consistent with disseminated histoplasmosis; fungal stains, culture and antigen testing are recommended for confirmation.

ddx.vs: Leishmania shows a nucleus plus a bar-shaped kinetoplast in each organism and no halo, which is not seen in these yeasts.
Talaromyces yeasts divide by binary fission with a central septum and elongated forms, rather than being uniformly oval with budding.
Cryptococcus is larger and more variable in size with a thick mucicarminophilic capsule, and is less often packed within macrophages.

ddx.dx: Phagocytosed platelets or cell debris in HLH
ddx.vs: Phagocytosed platelets and nuclear debris are irregular and lack a uniform oval shape with a nuclear dot and halo.

exam.answer_en: Disseminated histoplasmosis in bone marrow — macrophage containing a cluster of small uniform oval yeasts with clear halos
pearls_zh: 考法：在造血細胞背景中找出吞噬小酵母的巨噬細胞，再問病原與確認檢查；本圖未見明確噬血現象，不宜過度判讀為 HLH。
Histoplasma capsulatum 為 dimorphic fungus：人體組織內為 2–4 µm 酵母、環境中為菌絲，與鳥類或蝙蝠糞便污染的土壤有關。
移植病人可因潛伏感染再活化或捐贈器官帶菌而發病，免疫抑制下常播散至骨髓、肝脾與腎上腺。
骨髓切片可見肉芽腫或巨噬細胞內聚集酵母，GMS 染色最容易辨識。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把含顆粒的組織球當成噬血現象或 Leishmania；酵母大小一致、有偏心核點與透明暈且無 kinetoplast，也不是被吞噬的血球碎片。

quiz.q: Histoplasma capsulatum 在人體組織中呈現何種型態？
quiz.a: 小型（約 2–4 µm）細胞內酵母菌；它是 dimorphic fungus，環境中為菌絲型。

64390.recognize_zh: 周邊血中多顆中等大小的異常細胞，細胞質淡粉藍、只有極細小的顆粒（hypogranular），核呈腎形、摺疊或輕度分葉，染色質中度細緻，這種低顆粒、核摺疊的形態是微顆粒型 APL（M3v）的線索。
features: Intermediate-sized abnormal cells with moderate N:C ratio
Irregular, reniform to folded nuclei, some with early lobation or indentation
Moderately fine chromatin with small nucleoli in some cells
Moderate pale pink-blue cytoplasm with sparse, very fine azurophilic granules (hypogranular)
No Auer rods or faggot cells identified in this field; background red cells unremarkable with a single large platelet
64390.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows several intermediate-sized abnormal cells with reniform, folded or indented nuclei, moderately fine chromatin with small nucleoli, and a moderate rim of pale pink-blue cytoplasm containing only sparse, very fine granules. Auer rods and faggot cells are not seen in this field, and classic bilobed butterfly nuclei are only subtly suggested. Red cells are unremarkable and platelets appear decreased. Findings are suggestive of the microgranular (hypogranular) variant of acute promyelocytic leukemia; urgent confirmation by PML::RARA testing, strong MPO positivity and coagulation studies is required.

ddx.vs: Monocytic cells have folded nuclei too but show gray-blue vacuolated cytoplasm, lacy chromatin, nonspecific esterase positivity and weak MPO, whereas M3v is strongly MPO-positive and CD34-/HLA-DR-negative.
Mature monocytes have abundant gray cytoplasm with vacuoles and condensed chromatin and lack the uniform hypogranular promyelocyte-like appearance.
Classic APL shows densely granular cytoplasm obscuring the nucleus with frequent Auer rod bundles, whereas M3v has sparse, fine granules visible only on careful review or by electron microscopy.
NPM1-mutated AML can have nuclear invaginations and HLA-DR/CD34 negativity, so PML::RARA testing is needed to separate it.

exam.answer_en: Acute promyelocytic leukemia, microgranular variant (M3v) — hypogranular cells with folded/reniform nuclei; confirm PML::RARA urgently
pearls_zh: 考法：指核摺疊、顆粒極少的細胞問「單核球系還是 APL？」關鍵：M3v 的 MPO 強陽性、CD34/HLA-DR 多陰性，單核球系則 NSE 陽性、HLA-DR 陽性。
遺傳：t(15;17)(q24;q21) PML::RARA；M3v 常以白血球增多表現，較常伴 FLT3-ITD 與 bcr3（short form）轉錄本。
急症：DIC 合併纖溶亢進可致命出血；一懷疑 APL 就應立即開始 ATRA，不等基因結果，並積極補充 fibrinogen 與血小板。
治療：低/中風險以 ATRA 加 arsenic trioxide；注意 differentiation syndrome（發燒、呼吸窘迫、肺浸潤、體液滯留），以 dexamethasone 處理。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常被誤認為急性單核球性白血病；M3v 雖核摺疊且顆粒少，但 MPO 強陽性、HLA-DR 陰性，仔細找常可在少數細胞見到 Auer rods。

quiz.q: 臨床懷疑 M3v 時，在等待 PML::RARA 結果前應先做什麼處置？
quiz.a: 立即開始 ATRA，並監測與矯正 DIC（補充 fibrinogen、血小板）。

64070.recognize_zh: 這是正常周邊血抹片：紅血球大小一致、有中央淡染區；黃色箭頭為 3–5 葉分葉核的嗜中性球，綠色箭頭細胞質塞滿深紫色粗顆粒、遮蔽細胞核的是嗜鹼性球，紫色箭頭為細胞質灰藍、核形不規則的單核球，血小板數量正常。
features: Normocytic, normochromic red cells with central pallor and minimal anisopoikilocytosis
Segmented neutrophils (yellow arrows) with 3–5 nuclear lobes and pale pink finely granular cytoplasm
Basophil (green arrow) with coarse dark purple granules overlying and obscuring the nucleus
Monocyte (purple arrow) with irregular folded nucleus and grey-blue cytoplasm with an irregular border
Adequate scattered single platelets without clumping; no immature or atypical cells
64070.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows normocytic, normochromic red cells with preserved central pallor and no significant poikilocytosis. The white cells shown include mature segmented neutrophils without toxic change or hypersegmentation, a basophil with coarse dark purple granules obscuring the nucleus, and a monocyte with a folded nucleus and grey-blue cytoplasm. Platelets appear adequate in number and morphology. No blasts, nucleated red cells or inclusions are identified. Findings are consistent with a normal peripheral blood smear.

ddx.vs: Eosinophils have a bilobed nucleus that remains visible beneath uniform refractile orange-red granules, whereas basophil granules are dark purple-black and obscure the nucleus.
Toxic granules are fine, dark and evenly distributed over pale cytoplasm with a clearly visible segmented nucleus, not coarse granules masking the nucleus.
Reactive lymphocytes have deeply basophilic cytoplasm that scallops around red cells and a round nucleus, whereas monocytes have folded nuclei, lacy chromatin and grey-blue vacuolated cytoplasm.

64006.recognize_zh: 油鏡下可見一顆紅血球內有深紫色圓點（Howell-Jolly body）、一顆偏大偏藍的多染性紅血球（polychromatophil），並有邊緣缺角或凹陷的紅血球（bite cell），配合藥物史指向氧化性溶血。
features: Red cells show anisopoikilocytosis with numerous crenated cells (echinocytes), likely partly artifactual
Single dense round purple inclusion within a red cell consistent with a Howell-Jolly body
Occasional larger, bluish-grey polychromatophilic red cells
A few red cells with irregular peripheral defects or eccentric clearing suggestive of bite/blister cells
Fine punctate inclusions in some red cells; convincing coarse basophilic stippling is not clearly resolved
64006.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear (Leishman stain, high power) shows red cells with anisopoikilocytosis and many crenated forms, which may partly reflect drying artifact. A red cell containing a single dense round inclusion consistent with a Howell-Jolly body is present, along with polychromatophilic cells and occasional cells with peripheral bites or eccentric clearing. Fine punctate inclusions are seen in a few cells, but definite basophilic stippling is not clearly resolved at this resolution. In the appropriate drug history, findings are suggestive of oxidative (drug-induced) hemolysis.

ddx.vs: Morphology (bite and blister cells, Heinz bodies) is identical, so a G6PD enzyme assay after recovery of reticulocytosis is needed to separate it from drug-induced hemolysis in a G6PD-normal patient.
Immune hemolysis is characterized by spherocytes and a positive direct antiglobulin test rather than bite and blister cells.
Howell-Jolly bodies with target cells and acanthocytes but without bite/blister cells or Heinz bodies favor hyposplenism rather than oxidative hemolysis.
Artifactual echinocytes have evenly spaced short projections across many cells in thick areas and lack true peripheral bites or hemoglobin-free blisters.

63814.recognize_zh: 拼圖左上是著色性乾皮症（xeroderma pigmentosum）病人臉部的日曬雀斑樣色素斑、結痂與唇部病灶；下方與右側的骨髓抹片是大型芽細胞，核摺疊或腎形、染色質細緻、灰藍色細胞質帶空泡，屬單核球分化的芽細胞，對應 AML with monocytic maturation。
features: Clinical photographs: facial skin with numerous freckle-like hyperpigmented macules, crusted and scaly lesions and lip involvement (eyes masked); a second individual also photographed
Marrow smear: sheets of large blasts with high to moderate N:C ratio
Blast nuclei folded, indented or reniform with finely dispersed chromatin and small nucleoli
Moderate grey-blue cytoplasm with fine vacuoles; some cells with faint granules
Background small cells and red cells; no Auer rods clearly identified; staining with a pink cast limits fine detail
63814.describe_en: Composite figure. Clinical photographs show facial skin with extensive lentigo-like hyperpigmentation, crusting and lip involvement consistent with photodamage in xeroderma pigmentosum. The bone marrow aspirate smears show sheets of large blasts with folded or reniform nuclei, fine chromatin, small nucleoli and moderate amounts of grey-blue, finely vacuolated cytoplasm, features of monocytic differentiation; Auer rods are not clearly seen. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with monocytic maturation arising in a patient with xeroderma pigmentosum; confirmation requires blast enumeration, nonspecific esterase or flow cytometry (CD14, CD64, CD11b, CD36) and genetic studies.

ddx.vs: Microgranular APL cells have bilobed 'butterfly' nuclei with dust-like granules, strong MPO positivity, CD34/HLA-DR negativity and PML::RARA, whereas monocytic blasts are nonspecific esterase positive and HLA-DR positive.
CMML shows mature monocytes with blasts plus promonocytes below 20%, whereas this marrow consists of sheets of immature monocytic blasts.
Morphology is similar, so separation depends on a history of cytotoxic therapy or radiation, which is relevant in XP patients treated for skin cancers.
Lymphoma cells lack myeloid/monocytic markers and are positive for B- or T-cell antigens on flow cytometry or immunohistochemistry.

63750.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片 H&E（A）見成片、胞質豐富嗜酸性的大型組織球樣細胞混有小淋巴球；免疫染色這些細胞 S-100（B）胞質與核強陽性、CD1a（C）膜／胞質陽性、CD68（D）顆粒狀陽性，S-100 與 CD1a 共同陽性即指向蘭格漢斯細胞組織球增生症（LCH）。
features: H&E: sheets of large histiocytoid cells with abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and oval nuclei, admixed with small lymphocytes (A)
Distorted marrow architecture with background fibrosis/stromal change
S-100: strong cytoplasmic and nuclear staining of the large histiocytoid cells (B)
CD1a: membranous/cytoplasmic positivity in scattered to clustered large cells (C)
CD68: coarse granular cytoplasmic positivity in histiocytes (D)
Nuclear grooves and eosinophils are not clearly resolved at this magnification
63750.describe_en: Bone marrow trephine biopsy shows areas of distorted architecture with increased fibrosis and aggregates of large histiocytoid cells with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm and oval nuclei, admixed with small lymphocytes (A). Immunohistochemistry shows the lesional cells to be positive for S-100 with nuclear and cytoplasmic staining (B) and CD1a (C), with granular CD68 positivity in histiocytes (D). Characteristic grooved nuclei and eosinophils cannot be confidently assessed at this magnification. In a child with lytic bone lesions, the S-100 and CD1a co-expression supports marrow involvement by Langerhans cell histiocytosis; CD207 (langerin) and BRAF V600E studies would further confirm.

ddx.vs: RDD histiocytes are S-100 positive with emperipolesis but CD1a and CD207 negative.
HLH macrophages are CD68/CD163 positive but S-100 and CD1a negative, with hemophagocytosis rather than sheets of Langerhans cells.
These foamy histiocytes are CD68/CD163 and factor XIIIa positive but CD1a negative and usually S-100 negative.
Neuroblastoma in a child's marrow forms small round blue cell clusters with neuropil that are PHOX2B/synaptophysin positive, not large CD1a+ histiocytes.

exam.answer_en: Langerhans cell histiocytosis involving marrow — histiocytoid cells co-expressing S-100 and CD1a
pearls_zh: 讀法：S-100 與 CD1a 共同陽性確立 Langerhans cell 表型；CD207（langerin）是最特異的標記，CD68 不具鑑別性。
分子：約半數帶 BRAF V600E（VE1 IHC 或 PCR），其餘多為 MAP2K1 等 MAPK 路徑突變；WHO 5th 將組織球腫瘤歸於 myeloid neoplasm。
骨髓/造血、肝、脾為 risk organ，侵犯者屬高風險多系統 LCH，影響治療強度與預後。
形態：核有核溝（coffee-bean）並伴嗜酸性球；電顯可見網球拍狀 Birbeck granule。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 Rosai-Dorfman disease：RDD 也 S-100 陽性且有 emperipolesis，但 CD1a 與 CD207 陰性。

quiz.q: 哪兩個免疫染色共同陽性支持 LCH？最特異的標記是哪個？

63686.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓抽吸片中造血細胞非常稀少，背景多為紅血球，卻散布數個深紫色、緊密聚集的細胞團（箭頭），這種低倍下的「異常細胞團」是轉移性癌侵犯骨髓的第一個線索。
features: Multiple dense, dark purple cohesive cell clusters scattered across the smear (arrows)
Very scanty individual hematopoietic precursors between clusters
Background dominated by red cells with few fat droplets
Low magnification (x100) precludes assessment of individual cell cytology
63686.describe_en: Low-power view of a bone marrow aspirate smear shows a paucicellular background composed mainly of red cells with very scanty scattered hematopoietic precursors. Numerous discrete, dark-staining cohesive cell clusters are distributed across the smear (arrows). The cytologic features of the clustered cells cannot be evaluated at this magnification, and high-power examination is needed to confirm their epithelial nature. In a patient with known breast adenocarcinoma, findings are suggestive of diffuse metastatic carcinoma involving the bone marrow.

ddx.vs: Marrow particles contain fat and a mixed hematopoietic population, and megakaryocytes are single large cells, whereas tumor clusters are tight groups of uniform large cells on high power.
Platelet aggregates are small, pale, granular and anucleate, while tumor clusters contain large nuclei.
Hemodilution also gives scant hematopoietic cells but lacks cohesive nucleated clusters; correlation with the core biopsy is required.

63622.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓切片中，造血組織內有一個邊界清楚、顏色較淡粉紫的圓形結節，由類上皮組織球聚集而成，中央沒有壞死，周圍是正常三系造血與脂肪細胞，符合非壞死性肉芽腫（non-necrotizing granuloma）。
features: Well-circumscribed, pale-staining nodular aggregate of epithelioid histiocytes within hematopoietic marrow
No central caseous necrosis within the granuloma
Surrounding marrow mildly hypercellular with preserved trilineage hematopoiesis and fat spaces
Extensive areas of hemorrhage/red cells in the specimen, likely biopsy-related
Low magnification limits evaluation of giant cells and organisms
63622.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at low power shows a mildly hypercellular marrow with preserved trilineage hematopoiesis and interspersed fat. A well-circumscribed, pale-staining nodular aggregate of epithelioid histiocytes is present without central necrosis; additional areas of hemorrhage are noted, likely procedural. Giant cells and organisms cannot be assessed at this magnification. Findings are consistent with a non-necrotizing granuloma; in a patient with sarcoidosis this is supportive, but special stains for acid-fast bacilli and fungi and cultures are needed to exclude infection.

ddx.vs: Tuberculous granulomas often show caseous necrosis and AFB-positive organisms, and require microbiologic exclusion even when non-necrotizing.
Fungal granulomas may contain yeast forms demonstrable on GMS or PAS stains.
Lymphoid aggregates are composed of small dark lymphocytes rather than pale epithelioid histiocytes and are confirmed by CD20/CD3 immunostains.
Lipogranulomas are small histiocytic aggregates around fat vacuoles, commonly near sinusoids, without the compact epithelioid pattern.

63558.recognize_zh: 三顆嗜中性球的細胞質內含有多個淡藍色、長條或卵圓、帶透亮暈圈的菌體，排列成分節或出芽狀的假菌絲（pseudohyphae），代表白血球正在吞噬酵母菌（如 Candida）。
features: Three neutrophils containing intracytoplasmic organisms (arrows)
Organisms are blue, elongated to oval, with a clear halo/capsule-like space, some in branching chains with constrictions consistent with budding pseudohyphae
Phagocytosed organisms displace and compress the lobated neutrophil nucleus
Organisms are much larger than bacteria and lack the tiny uniform dot-like morphology of Histoplasma
Background: thick area of smear with crowded, overlapping red cells and a small platelet or nuclear fragment
63558.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear (May-Grünwald stain, 1000x) shows three neutrophils containing phagocytosed fungal elements (arrows). The organisms are pale blue, oval to elongated structures surrounded by a clear halo, several arranged in short segmented, budding chains consistent with pseudohyphae, and they indent the neutrophil nuclei. The background is a thick area of the smear with overlapping red cells. Findings are consistent with fungemia with neutrophil phagocytosis of yeast and pseudohyphae, most suggestive of Candida species; blood cultures and species identification are required.

ddx.vs: Histoplasma yeasts are small (2-4 micrometers), uniform, oval with a crescentic nuclear dot and pseudocapsule, typically within monocytes/macrophages, and do not form pseudohyphae.
Döhle bodies are pale blue-grey amorphous cytoplasmic patches at the cell periphery without a refractile wall, halo or budding.
Bacilli are much smaller, darker and uniform rods without clear halos or budding segmentation.
Platelets are purple granular fragments and precipitate is dark and in a different plane, whereas these organisms are within vacuoles with defined walls.

exam.answer_en: Fungemia, likely Candida — neutrophils containing phagocytosed yeasts and budding pseudohyphae with clear halos
pearls_zh: 考法：指嗜中性球內帶透亮暈的藍色長條結構問是什麼：酵母菌與假菌絲（Candida），並要求立即通報、送血液培養。
血片直接看到菌體代表菌量高，常見於中心靜脈導管、嗜中性球低下或加護病房病人；需考慮移除導管並開始抗黴菌治療。
與 Histoplasma 區分：Histoplasma 為 2–4 μm 小卵圓酵母、多在單核球/巨噬細胞內、無假菌絲；Candida 較大且可出芽成鏈。
PAS 或 GMS 染色可凸顯黴菌細胞壁，協助確認。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 Döhle bodies 或疊在細胞上的血小板；Döhle body 是胞質周邊淡藍無定形斑塊，無透亮暈圈與出芽，菌體輪廓清楚並壓迫細胞核。

quiz.q: 嗜中性球內帶透亮暈、呈分節鏈狀的結構是什麼？

63494.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片免疫染色中，密集的小圓形細胞大多只呈藍色核對比染色，僅部分細胞核呈淡棕灰色、偶見少量棕色點狀陽性；標記名稱未標示，也看不到明顯壞死，只能當作白血病免疫染色的一部分來判讀。
features: Densely packed small to intermediate round cells replacing the marrow
Predominantly negative staining with blue hematoxylin counterstain
Weak to moderate brownish nuclear tinge in a subset of cells
Rare scattered cells with small brown cytoplasmic dots
Marker not identified; necrosis not clearly discernible at this magnification
63494.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain on a bone marrow biopsy shows a diffuse, densely cellular infiltrate of small to intermediate round cells. Most cells are negative or show only weak brownish nuclear staining, with rare cells containing small cytoplasmic brown dots. The antibody is not indicated and the staining is weak, so the result cannot be confidently interpreted as positive or negative from this image. Interpretation requires correlation with the stated diagnosis of acute leukemia with focal coagulative necrosis and the remainder of the immunophenotypic panel.

ddx.vs: Confirmation requires nuclear TdT and B-lineage markers (PAX5, CD79a, CD19) with definite rather than equivocal staining.
Would be supported by MPO or CD117 positivity in the blasts and absence of B-lineage markers.

ddx.dx: Non-specific staining in necrotic or poorly fixed marrow
ddx.vs: Weak diffuse brownish nuclear tinge without crisp positive/negative contrast can reflect necrosis or decalcification artifact rather than true antigen expression.

63366.recognize_zh: 上方凝膠卡的 anti-A、anti-B 與 control 孔都呈 mixed-field（MF），下方抹片紅血球聚成不規則團塊（agglutination）並有血小板聚集；control 陽性代表冷凝集素干擾血型判讀。
features: Gel card: mixed-field reactions with anti-A, anti-B and the control well; 4+ with anti-D
Reverse typing: 3+ agglutination with A1 and B cells (consistent with group O plasma)
Positive control well indicates an invalid forward type due to autoagglutination
Smear: numerous irregular three-dimensional red cell clumps (agglutination), not linear rouleaux stacks
Platelet clumps present; background of non-agglutinated normocytic red cells
63366.describe_en: Composite image of automated gel ABO/RhD typing and a peripheral blood smear. The gel card shows mixed-field reactions in the anti-A, anti-B and control columns with 4+ anti-D and 3+ reverse reactions with A1 and B cells; the reactive control invalidates the forward type and indicates autoagglutination. The smear shows extensive irregular red cell agglutinates with platelet clumps. Findings are consistent with a potent cold agglutinin causing ABO typing discrepancy, resolved by warm-washed cells and prewarmed plasma.

ddx.vs: Rouleaux form linear coin-like stacks that disperse with saline replacement, whereas agglutinates are irregular clusters with a positive C3d DAT.
Warm AIHA shows spherocytes with IgG-positive DAT and typically no gross agglutination or control-well reactivity at room temperature.

ddx.dx: Recent out-of-group transfusion or chimerism (true mixed field)
ddx.vs: True mixed-field from two cell populations does not make the antisera-free control well positive and persists after warm washing.

exam.answer_en: Cold agglutinin with ABO typing discrepancy — mixed-field forward typing with positive control and RBC agglutinates on smear
pearls_zh: 考法：考官問「正向 anti-A、anti-B 與 control 都 MF，反向 A1、B cells 3+，血型是什麼？」答正向無效，反向提示 O 型，需去除冷凝集後重驗。
紅血球凝集為不規則立體團塊，rouleaux 則為線狀疊錢；rouleaux 以生理食鹽水置換（saline replacement）可分散，冷凝集則需加溫。
冷凝集素病（CAD）屬補體介導血管外溶血為主，DAT C3d 陽性；避免受寒、輸血時使用血液加溫器。
繼發性 CAD 多隨感染緩解而改善；原發性 CAD 可用 rituximab 為基礎治療，sutimlimab（anti-C1s）亦已核准用於 CAD。
exam.pitfall_zh: 紅血球團塊易誤為 rouleaux；rouleaux 為線狀疊錢且 saline replacement 可分散，冷凝集為不規則葡萄串團塊並伴 control 陽性。

quiz.q: 此病人正向定型 control 孔陽性、反向 A1 與 B cells 皆 3+，最可能的真實 ABO 血型與判讀問題為何？
quiz.a: 可能為 O 型；冷凝集素自體凝集使正向定型無效，需 37°C 洗滌後重驗

63302.recognize_zh: 新生兒周邊血液中見到一顆核質比高、染色質細緻、胞質少且帶小泡狀突起（cytoplasmic bleb）的芽細胞，結合唐氏症嬰兒、白血球與血小板增加的臨床資料，符合唐氏症相關暫時性異常骨髓生成（TAM）。
features: Single medium-sized blast with very high N:C ratio and round nucleus
Finely dispersed chromatin; nucleoli not clearly resolved at this magnification
Scant deeply basophilic cytoplasm with a small cytoplasmic bleb/bud (megakaryoblast-like)
Numerous platelets including a large, pale granular platelet form
Background red cells with prominent crenation (echinocytes), likely partly artifactual, and occasional polychromatic macrocytes
63302.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear from a neonate shows a circulating blast with a very high N:C ratio, finely dispersed chromatin and scant basophilic cytoplasm bearing a small cytoplasmic bleb, a feature suggestive of megakaryoblastic differentiation. Platelets are numerous, with occasional large forms. Red cells show marked crenation, likely related to smear preparation, with occasional polychromatic cells. In a neonate with Down syndrome, leukocytosis, thrombocytosis and 18-19% myeloid blasts (CD33+, CD117+), findings are consistent with transient abnormal myelopoiesis; GATA1 mutation testing and follow-up are recommended.

ddx.dx: Myeloid leukemia associated with Down syndrome
ddx.vs: ML-DS usually presents after the neonatal period (typically before age 4) with cytopenias and marrow fibrosis, whereas TAM presents in the first weeks and often resolves spontaneously; morphology of the blasts is similar.

ddx.dx: Congenital acute megakaryoblastic leukemia without Down syndrome
ddx.vs: Non-DS congenital AMKL lacks trisomy 21/GATA1 mutation, frequently carries RBM15::MRTFA, and does not regress spontaneously.

ddx.dx: Neonatal reactive leukocytosis with circulating immature cells
ddx.vs: Reactive states show left-shifted granulocytes and nucleated red cells but lack a clonal CD34/CD117+ megakaryoblastic blast population.
Lymphoid cells have more condensed chromatin and lack cytoplasmic blebs, and express B- or T-cell rather than myeloid/megakaryocytic markers.

exam.answer_en: Transient abnormal myelopoiesis of Down syndrome — circulating megakaryoblast-like blast with cytoplasmic bleb, with thrombocytosis
pearls_zh: 考法：指帶胞質泡狀突起的芽細胞問系別傾向（megakaryoblast），再結合唐氏症新生兒問診斷（TAM）與相關基因（GATA1 突變）。
TAM 見於約 10% 唐氏症新生兒（包括 trisomy 21 嵌合型），多在出生後數週內出現，大多在 3 個月內自行消退。
分子：GATA1 exon 2 突變產生截短的 GATA1s；約 20–30% 會在 4 歲前進展為 ML-DS，進展需要額外突變（如 cohesin、CTCF、JAK-STAT 路徑）。
免疫表型：CD34+、CD117+、CD33+，常表現 CD41/CD61，並可異常表現 CD7、CD56。
重症 TAM 可合併肝纖維化、水腫/積水與凝血異常而致命；有症狀者可考慮低劑量 cytarabine。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易被當成新生兒反應性白血球增多或 ALL；此芽細胞帶胞質泡狀突起、表現 CD41/CD61，且病童為唐氏症並帶 GATA1 突變。

quiz.q: 唐氏症新生兒周邊血出現此類帶胞質泡狀突起的芽細胞，最可能的診斷與相關基因突變為何？

63238.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中有數顆嗜中性球，胞質內含一大團均質、沒有染色質紋路的淡紫色圓形物質（LE body），把分葉核擠到邊緣呈新月形；這就是典型的 LE 細胞（LE cell）。
features: Neutrophils containing a large, round, smooth, homogeneous pale purple intracytoplasmic mass (LE body)
Host neutrophil nucleus compressed and displaced to the periphery, often crescent-shaped
Inclusion lacks chromatin texture, nucleoli or nuclear membrane detail, indicating denatured opsonized nuclear material
Background hypercellular aspirate with granulocytic predominance across maturation stages and scattered erythroid precursors
63238.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is hypercellular with a myeloid predominance showing orderly maturation. Scattered neutrophils contain large, round, homogeneous, structureless pale purple intracytoplasmic bodies that compress and displace the neutrophil nucleus to the periphery. The inclusions lack a chromatin pattern, distinguishing them from engulfed intact nuclei. Findings are consistent with LE cells, supporting the clinical diagnosis of systemic lupus erythematosus.

ddx.vs: The host is usually a monocyte and the ingested nucleus retains recognizable chromatin structure, whereas the LE body is swollen and homogeneous.

ddx.dx: Neutrophil with phagocytosed apoptotic body or bacteria
ddx.vs: Apoptotic debris appears as dense pyknotic fragments and bacteria as small discrete rods or cocci, not a single swollen homogeneous lilac mass.

ddx.dx: Free smudged nucleus (hematoxylin body) overlapping a neutrophil
ddx.vs: A free nucleus lies beside or on top of the neutrophil without the host nucleus wrapped around it; the LE body must be truly engulfed.

exam.answer_en: LE cells — neutrophils containing a large homogeneous LE body that displaces the nucleus into a crescent, supporting SLE
pearls_zh: 考法：指含均質淡紫色團塊的嗜中性球問「LE cell」，重點追問 LE body 為何沒有染色質紋路（抗體調理後的變性核物質）。
LE cell 形成需要時間，屬體外（in vitro）現象，檢體放置後較易出現；LE cell prep 敏感度不如 ANA，已不作常規診斷。
SLE 血液學表現：DAT 陽性自體免疫溶血、免疫性血小板減少、白血球/淋巴球減少，以及抗磷脂症候群（lupus anticoagulant 使 aPTT 延長但增加血栓）。
自體抗體：anti-dsDNA 與 anti-Smith 對 SLE 特異性高；anti-histone 見於藥物性狼瘡。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與 tart cell 或吞噬細菌/凋亡小體的嗜中性球混淆：LE body 為單一腫脹均質團塊並把宿主核推到邊緣，tart cell 吞噬物仍保留染色質結構。

quiz.q: 嗜中性球胞質內均質、無染色質紋路的大團塊稱為什麼？

63174.recognize_zh: 一顆分葉嗜中性球周圍被十多個血小板緊密圍成一圈（platelet satellitism），旁邊另一顆嗜中性球則沒有，是 EDTA 引起偽血小板低下的典型形態。
features: Segmented neutrophil ringed by about 14 closely adherent platelets (platelet satellitism)
Adherent platelets are small, granular and evenly spaced around the cell membrane
Neighbouring neutrophil without platelet rosetting
Small dense round nucleated cell adjacent to the neutrophil (small lymphocyte or nucleated red cell)
Few free platelets in background; dark stain precipitate present; red cells unremarkable
63174.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a segmented neutrophil surrounded by a ring of approximately 14 platelets adherent to its surface, while an adjacent neutrophil lacks this change. Free platelets in the background are relatively sparse, and red cell morphology is unremarkable apart from stain precipitate. Findings are consistent with EDTA-dependent platelet satellitism, a cause of spurious thrombocytopenia; a repeat count in citrated blood or a fingerstick smear is recommended.

ddx.vs: Clumping forms free aggregates of platelets in the background or feathered edge rather than a ring around neutrophils, though both cause pseudothrombocytopenia.
True thrombocytopenia has few platelets without satellitism or clumps and persists in citrate-anticoagulated samples.

ddx.dx: Red cell rosetting around a neutrophil
ddx.vs: Rosettes consist of intact red cells, not small granular platelets, around the leukocyte.
Phagocytosed platelets lie within the cytoplasm rather than adhering around the outer membrane.

exam.answer_en: Platelet satellitism — platelets rosetting around a neutrophil in EDTA blood, causing pseudothrombocytopenia
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指被血小板圍成一圈的嗜中性球問現象名稱，接著問「血小板計數 30×10⁹/L 但病人無出血，下一步？」答：看抹片、改用 citrate 管重抽。
機轉：EDTA 依賴性自體抗體同時結合血小板 GPIIb/IIIa 與嗜中性球 FcγRIII（CD16），使血小板貼附在白血球表面而被計數儀漏算。
處理：以 sodium citrate 管重測（結果需乘以抗凝劑稀釋校正約 1.1）或 heparin 管、指尖血抹片估算；本身不會造成出血。
臨床意義在於避免誤診 ITP、不必要的血小板輸注、停抗凝或骨髓檢查；檢驗報告應註明 satellitism。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與 EDTA 誘發的血小板凝集（clumping）混為一談；clumping 是背景或羽毛邊緣的游離血小板團，satellitism 則是血小板環繞白血球，兩者皆造成偽血小板低下。

quiz.q: 圖中嗜中性球周圍的構造形成何種現象？會讓自動血小板計數出現什麼錯誤？
quiz.a: Platelet satellitism；EDTA-dependent pseudothrombocytopenia（血小板假性偏低）

63110.recognize_zh: 低倍脾臟切片可見互相吻合、充滿紅血球的大小不一血管腔隙，部分呈囊狀擴張並有乳突狀突起，左側保留正常白髓淋巴組織；此血管性病灶取代紅髓，符合脾臟 littoral cell angioma。
features: Low-power splenic tissue with anastomosing, blood-filled vascular channels of variable size
Cystically dilated spaces with papillary projections into lumina
Channels lined by plump cells separated by fibrous and cellular septa
Residual white pulp lymphoid tissue at left edge
Lining cell detail (hobnail/tall cells, hemophagocytosis) not resolvable at this magnification
63110.describe_en: Sections of spleen at low power show a vascular lesion composed of anastomosing, blood-filled channels of variable caliber, including cystically dilated spaces with papillary projections, separated by fibrous and cellular septa. Residual white pulp is present at the periphery. No solid atypical cellular proliferation or necrosis is evident at this magnification, though the cytology of the lining cells requires high-power examination. Findings are consistent with littoral cell angioma, confirmed by the characteristic hybrid endothelial-histiocytic immunophenotype (CD31+, CD68+, CD163+, CD21+, CD8−, CD34−).

ddx.vs: Hemangioma channels are lined by flat CD34+/CD31+ endothelium that is negative for CD68, CD163, and CD21.
Angiosarcoma shows cytologic atypia, solid areas, mitoses, necrosis, and infiltrative growth.
SANT forms multiple angiomatoid nodules with a mixture of CD34+ capillaries, CD8+ sinusoids, and CD31-only small veins, surrounded by concentric fibrosis.
Peliosis consists of blood-filled cysts lacking a true lining cell proliferation or papillary projections.

63046.recognize_zh: 高倍鏡下可見粗厚且形狀不規則的骨小樑，邊緣有扇貝狀凹陷，骨髓腔完全被含梭形細胞與小血管的疏鬆纖維血管組織取代、沒有造血細胞，是 Paget 骨病骨髓的表現。
features: Thick, irregularly shaped bony trabeculae with scalloped, notched surfaces
Osteocytes within lacunae; faint irregular cement lines in places
Marrow spaces replaced by loose, vacuolated fibrovascular stroma with bland spindle and stellate cells and small capillaries
Absent hematopoietic cells and fat in the marrow spaces
Osteoclasts not conspicuous in this field; no atypical or tumor cells
63046.describe_en: High-power view of the bone marrow trephine shows thick, irregular trabeculae with scalloped surfaces containing osteocytes in lacunae. The marrow spaces are entirely replaced by loose, edematous fibrovascular connective tissue with bland spindle cells and small capillaries, and hematopoietic elements are absent. Osteoclasts are not prominent in this particular field, and no malignant cells are identified. Findings are consistent with Paget disease of bone, correlating with the sclerotic lesions and elevated alkaline phosphatase.

ddx.vs: Prostate metastases contain glands or cords of epithelial cells positive for keratin, PSA and NKX3.1 within the stroma, absent here.
Myelofibrosis retains atypical clustered megakaryocytes and dilated sinusoids with intrasinusoidal hematopoiesis, not a bland vascular connective tissue.
Renal osteodystrophy shows tunneling resorption, osteoid seams and peritrabecular fibrosis with chronic kidney disease.

62982.recognize_zh: 腦部 MRI 有周圍水腫的環狀病灶、胸部 CT 有肺部實質化與肋膜積液，組織切片見混合發炎細胞中淡棕色的分隔菌絲；玻片培養（lactophenol cotton blue）見分隔菌絲與雙細胞棒狀分生孢子，培養皿為深橄欖褐色菌落並釋出紅褐色色素，符合嗜熱暗色真菌 Verruconis gallopava 感染。
features: MRI brain T2 (A): left parietal ring-like lesion with a hypointense rim and surrounding vasogenic edema
MRI spine (B) and CT chest (C): additional lesions, with lung consolidation/effusion on CT
Tissue H&E (D): mixed inflammatory infiltrate with histiocytes and neutrophils and faintly pigmented, septate hyphal fragments
Lactophenol cotton blue mount (E): thin septate hyphae bearing clavate to cylindrical two-celled conidia
Culture plate (F): dark olive-brown to black velvety colonies with a red-brown diffusible pigment in the agar
62982.describe_en: Composite figure. Brain MRI shows a ring-like parietal lesion with surrounding edema, and spine MRI and chest CT show additional sites of disease including pulmonary consolidation. Tissue biopsy shows a mixed inflammatory infiltrate containing faintly pigmented septate hyphal elements. The lactophenol cotton blue mount from culture shows septate hyphae with clavate two-celled conidia, and the culture plate grows dark olive-brown colonies producing a reddish-brown diffusible pigment. Findings are consistent with disseminated phaeohyphomycosis due to Verruconis gallopava in an immunosuppressed patient with myelofibrosis on ruxolitinib.

ddx.vs: Aspergillus hyphae are hyaline with acute-angle branching and form conidial heads with phialides, not pigmented hyphae with two-celled clavate conidia.
Mucorales have broad, ribbon-like pauciseptate hyphae with right-angle branching and non-pigmented colonies.
These produce chains of one-celled conidia or annellides, whereas Verruconis is thermotolerant with two-celled conidia and a red-brown diffusible pigment; sequencing confirms.
Nocardia forms thin beaded branching filaments that are modified acid-fast and grow as chalky white bacterial colonies.

62982.stain: MRI/CT; H&E; lactophenol cotton blue; culture

62918.recognize_zh: 視野中有高核質比、染色質細緻、細胞質少的母細胞，同時混有數個核偏位、細胞質豐富深藍的漿細胞（plasma cells）；母細胞加上反應性漿細胞增多，需結合流式 cCD3/TdT 才能歸為 T-ALL。
features: Intermediate to large blasts with high N:C ratio and round to oval nuclei
Fine, evenly dispersed chromatin with small or inconspicuous nucleoli
Scant agranular cytoplasm; some cells show multiple small clear vacuoles overlying the cell
Several plasma cells with eccentric round nuclei, clumped chromatin, and abundant deep basophilic cytoplasm
Small mature lymphocytes present
Background with lysed cells, platelet debris, and a bluish amorphous stromal fragment
62918.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a mixed population of immature mononuclear cells and plasma cells. The blasts are intermediate to large with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, fine chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli, and scant agranular cytoplasm, some with small vacuoles; Auer rods are not identified. Several mature-appearing plasma cells with eccentric nuclei, perinuclear clearing, and abundant basophilic cytoplasm are interspersed. The blast lineage cannot be determined on morphology alone; with the immunophenotype (cCD3+, CD5+, TdT+), findings are consistent with T-lymphoblastic leukemia accompanied by polyclonal plasmacytosis.

ddx.vs: Identical blast morphology; separated only by immunophenotype (CD19/CD79a/CD10 positive, cytoplasmic CD3 negative).

ddx.dx: Plasma cell myeloma or plasma cell leukemia
ddx.vs: Neoplastic plasma cells are light-chain restricted and usually CD56+ with an M-band, while here plasma cells are polyclonal and a separate TdT+ blast population is present.
Myeloblasts may show granules or Auer rods and are MPO positive, unlike these MPO-negative, cCD3-positive blasts.

62854.recognize_zh: 一顆大型三核細胞，三個圓形核染色質細緻、位於周邊，深藍色細胞質內散布細小空泡，具漿細胞樣分化特徵，代表核分裂未伴隨細胞分裂；周圍有小淋巴球與紅血球母細胞，圖中未能清楚辨認 Russell 小體。
features: Large atypical cell with three round, peripherally placed nuclei
Nuclei with finely granular chromatin and indistinct nucleoli
Moderately abundant basophilic cytoplasm containing multiple small clear vacuoles
Plasmacytoid features; distinct Russell bodies not clearly seen
Surrounding small lymphocytes, erythroblasts and a band neutrophil
62854.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large atypical trinucleated cell with three round, peripherally placed nuclei, finely granular chromatin and moderately abundant basophilic cytoplasm containing numerous small clear vacuoles. The appearance suggests nuclear division without cytokinesis in a cell with plasmacytoid differentiation, although well-formed Russell bodies are not clearly identifiable in this image. Small lymphocytes, erythroid precursors and a band neutrophil are present nearby. In a patient with CLL, findings are consistent with atypical multinucleated plasmablastic cells, supporting Richter transformation to plasmablastic lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Osteoclasts are much larger with many (often >5) uniform separate nuclei and abundant granular pink-purple cytoplasm.
Megakaryocytes have a single multilobated polyploid nucleus and granular cytoplasm rather than separate nuclei in basophilic vacuolated cytoplasm.

ddx.dx: Plasma cell myeloma with multinucleated plasma cells
ddx.vs: Multinucleated myeloma cells can look identical, so clinical M-protein, CRAB features and prior CLL history with immunophenotype are needed.
RS cells have large inclusion-like macronucleoli and are CD30/CD15 positive, lacking plasmacytoid basophilic cytoplasm.

62790.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片可見體積很大、雙核或多核的漿細胞（偏位核、細胞質豐富嗜雙性），抹片中也有巨大多核細胞與不典型漿細胞，CD138膜染色勾勒出成群大型漿細胞，符合移植後EBV相關漿細胞骨髓瘤型PTLD。
features: Large atypical plasma cells with abundant amphophilic cytoplasm, eccentric nuclei, and frequent binucleation or multinucleation (A)
Aspirate with a giant multinucleated cell and scattered atypical plasmacytoid cells among hematopoietic elements (B, C)
Strong membranous CD138-like staining outlining large neoplastic plasma cells in clusters (D; marker not labeled)
Weaker, patchy staining of a subset of cells on a second immunostain (E; marker not labeled)
H&E field with interstitial infiltrate adjacent to vessels/fat (F); low resolution limits detail
62790.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows an infiltrate of large atypical plasma cells with abundant amphophilic cytoplasm, eccentric nuclei and frequent bi- or multinucleation. The aspirate smears contain scattered atypical plasmacytoid cells and occasional giant multinucleated forms. Immunostains highlight clusters of large neoplastic plasma cells with strong membranous staining and a second marker staining a subset (antibodies not labeled in the figure). Resolution limits evaluation of nucleoli and inclusions. In a transplant recipient, and with EBV demonstration, findings are consistent with monomorphic post-transplant lymphoproliferative disorder of plasma cell myeloma type with large multinucleated plasma cells.

ddx.vs: Megakaryocytes have lobulated nuclei and granular pink cytoplasm and are CD61/CD42b positive and CD138 negative, unlike multinucleated plasma cells with perinuclear hof.
Plasmablastic lymphoma consists of sheets of immunoblast-like cells with very high Ki-67 and usually presents as an extramedullary mass rather than marrow-based mature plasma cell morphology.
Reactive plasma cells are small, mature and polytypic for kappa and lambda, without multinucleated giant forms.
Carcinoma cells form cohesive clusters and are cytokeratin positive, lacking cytoplasmic immunoglobulin light chain.

62726.recognize_zh: 20倍下周邊血液白血球明顯增多，多為核雙葉的不成熟細胞，同時可見多處紅血球成團聚集（agglutination），提示APL高白血球血症合併自體免疫性溶血。
features: Hyperleukocytosis with numerous medium to large mononuclear cells, many with bilobed nuclei
Multiple irregular clumps of agglutinated red cells scattered across the field
Remaining red cells show crenation and anisocytosis
A few smaller mature lymphocytes/neutrophils admixed
Magnification too low to assess granules or Auer rods
62726.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at intermediate magnification shows marked leukocytosis composed mainly of medium to large immature cells, many with bilobed nuclei, consistent with abnormal promyelocytes. Numerous irregular clumps of agglutinated red cells are distributed throughout the smear. Granules and Auer rods cannot be assessed at this magnification. Findings are consistent with microgranular acute promyelocytic leukemia with hyperleukocytosis and red cell agglutination, suggestive of an associated autoimmune hemolytic process (direct antiglobulin test recommended).

ddx.vs: Cold agglutinin disease shows similar red cell clumping that disperses on warming but lacks a leukemic population of abnormal promyelocytes.
Rouleaux are linear 'stack of coins' arrangements seen with increased plasma proteins, whereas agglutinates are irregular three-dimensional clumps.
Monocytic blasts lack bilobed promyelocyte morphology and are HLA-DR positive and PML-RARA negative.

62662.recognize_zh: 左側淋巴組織中可見成群的大型多形性細胞，細胞質豐富、核大且有明顯核仁，部分為多核或怪異核，呈免疫母細胞/漿母細胞樣（immunoblastic/plasmablastic），群聚於竇狀空間；右側為纖維性被膜，符合結外型原發性滲出性淋巴瘤（extracavitary PEL）的組織型態。
